---
title: "CSS Generic Font Family Test"
brand: _brand.yml
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      # Divergence from Q1, which asserts the generic keyword is preserved
      # (`font: ("Roboto", "sans-serif")`). Typst has no generic families, so
      # Q2 replaces each keyword with the first available font from a
      # candidate list. Which font wins differs per machine, so only
      # platform-independent facts are asserted: no keyword reaches the .typ
      # (and, via the default warning gate, Typst reports no unknown family).
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'font: \("[^"]+"'
          - 'codefont: \("[^"]+"'
        -
          - '"sans-serif"'
          - '"monospace"'
---

Verifies that CSS generic font family names (sans-serif, monospace) are
resolved to a concrete available font rather than passed through to Typst.
